newsitem.title: UK: HSBC Saudi unit boosts net income.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Saudi unit boosts net income.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc said its subsidiary Saudi British Bank made net income of $96 million in the nine months to September 30 against $81 million in the same period last year.
Customer deposits rose to $5.6 billion from $4.7 billion. Investment securities increased to $3.7 billion from $2.9 billion and total assets to $8.2 billion from $6.9 billion.
Loans and advances net of provisions for bad and doubtful debts were virtually unchanged at $2.6 billion, reflecting the lack of demand in the Saudi Arabian business community.

Managing director Ron Shaw said in a statement the bank expected increased demand for loans and advances next year from large projects being undertaken by Saudi Arabian Oil Company, Saudi Consolidated Electric Company Eastern Province and Saudi Basic Industries Corp. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
